title: Debloater configuration document
description: Configuration as code: what a site has chosen, in a form that can be committed to a repository and applied elsewhere. Produced by `wp debloater export` and consumed by `wp debloater import`. It carries choices only — never findings, scores, snapshots or run history, which describe one site at one moment and cannot be transplanted.

schema_version.description: Format version of this document. Bumped only when the shape changes incompatibly.

plugin_version.description: Version of Debloater that produced the document.

registry_hash.description: Hash of the change registry the document was written against. Provenance, not a gate: a mismatch is worth a warning, since a change may mean something slightly different now, but it never refuses the import.

site_hash.description: The site the document came from. Informational only — importing another site's configuration is the entire point of the format.

intent_profile.description: What the site is for and how much change its owner wants. Travels with the selection because the two were decided together.

selection.description: Selected changes, keyed by tweak id, each with the parameters it was selected with. An empty object is valid and means nothing is selected.
